bullet_points.text: Developed ServiceNow applications to automate internal workflows, reducing normal processing time by ~25-40% for requests
Collaborated with cross-functional stakeholders to gather requirements and deliver iterative enhancements, supporting 10+ internal users across multiple teams
Managed multiple project teams, ensuring steady progress and successful completion of goals
Provided feedback and suggestions to improve event messaging on social media and messaging platforms
Developed key app features, including user availability, chat, status updates, and friend/group invites
Implemented real-time features using WebSockets, including group invites, messaging, and message statuses
Integrated third-party APIs, such as Google Places for event location autocomplete and Apple Calendar
Supervised and assisted students using the computer lab with technical or software issues
Set up and maintained lab computers, including desktops, monitors, and peripherals
